title: Director of Financial Management
description:
Overview

The United States Space Force (USSF) Headquarters (HQ) located at the Pentagon is searching for a Director of Financial Management (NH- , GS-14/15 Equivalent).

Description: Are you ready to make a direct impact on the future of space operations, national security, and the global defense strategy? The U.S. Space Force is seeking a visionary and dynamic leader to serve as the Director of Financial Management, a pivotal role that will shape the future of space defense and influence strategic decisions at the highest levels. As the Director of Financial Management, you will be at the forefront of leading and managing critical initiatives that drive the success of the U.S. Space Force's mission. You\'ll lead a talented team of experts, overseeing complex programs and high-stakes projects that support space superiority, innovation, and operational excellence. You\'ll have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership, both within the Space Force and across the Department of Defense, ensuring that we remain agile, responsive, and capable of meeting today\'s challenges while preparing for the challenges of tomorrow.

You will lead and manage the completion of special projects, initiatives, assignments and represent the directorate with a variety of functional area organizations. Establish, develop, and maintain effective working relationships with a variety of high-level offices. Meets with key customers and coordinating officials to assess customer satisfaction, explain organization policy and procedures, and resolve significant problems that arise. Ensure subordinate units provide customer guidance and training. Identifies the need for special projects and initiates milestones and goals.

The ideal candidate will organize and manage the financial activities of the USSF and serve as the primary advisor to the Vice Chief of Space Operations and Director of Staff on a wide range of financial management issues and the financial audit. Manages and directs command-wide budgeting and financial services activities, including a financial audit program office and associated service-wide governance. Manages the development of USSF-wide plans, program goals, policies, and procedures, particularly associated with annual budget execution and financial audits. DoD and financial audit experience is required and experience working across large, complex organizations is desired.

Key Skills and Abilities

  1. Mastery of budgetary and financial functions, operations, policies, procedures, and practices and the concepts, theories, and practices of the specialist work performed in the subordinate organizations.
  2. Knowledge of personnel management, EEO, safety and security regulations, practices, and procedures.
  3. Knowledge of Financial Improvement and Audit Readiness activities and objectives, specifically cost analysis, cost estimating, cost performance, cost techniques, auditing, and budget analysis.
  4. Ability to plan, organize, and direct the functions and mentor, motivate, and appraise the staff of an organization through subordinate supervisors.
  5. Ability to analyze, plan, and adjust work operations of one or more organizational segments to meet program requirements and objectives within available resources.
  6. Ability to communicate both orally and in writing.
  7. Ability to work across enterprise organizations, Secretariat, Space Force, Air Force, etc...

Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship Required
  • Eligible for situational telework only, including Emergency and OPM prescribed “Unscheduled Telework”.
  • PCS is authorized and paid IAW JTR and AF Regulations. If receiving an authorized PCS, you may be subject to completing/signing a CONUS agreement. More information on PCS requirements, may be found at:
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
  • Required to handle and safeguard sensitive and classified information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.
  • This is a drug testing designated position. The incumbent is subject to pre-employment drug testing as a condition of employment, and participation in random drug testing.
  • This is a Supervisory position being filled.
  • May be subject to recall during other than normal duty hours and may be required to work overtime on an unscheduled or emergency basis.
  • Employee must within 30-days of assuming this position and annually thereafter, file an OGE-450, “Confidential Financial Disclosure Report.” Employee is required to attend annual ethics and procurement integrity training.
  • This is a Financial Management Level (3) Certified position IAW the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) 2012, Public Law 112-81, Subtitle F-Financial Management, Section 1599d.
  • Subject to Temporary Duty Assignment (TDY): Approximately 30 days per year.
  • May be required travel by military or commercial aircraft in the performance of TDY assignments.
  • This position will close after 10 business days or 100 applications.

title: Director, Mergers & Acquisitions
description:
Overview

Director, Mergers & Acquisitions at Toptal. This is a remote position. You will lead the identification, assessment, and execution of acquisition opportunities that align with Toptal’s strategic growth objectives—particularly in the talent, IT services, and tech product ecosystems. You will be directly responsible for sourcing and initiating M&A discussions, owning deal execution, and supporting post-acquisition integration and performance tracking. This role requires a strong operator who can manage multiple concurrent deals under time pressure, balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and clearly communicate complex deal theses to C-level stakeholders. You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, People, and others to evaluate opportunities and build scalable diligence and integration frameworks.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communications must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Origination & Sourcing
  • Identify and proactively reach out to small business owners and founders in the talent, IT services, and adjacent sectors to build a high-quality acquisition pipeline.
  • Develop and test creative sourcing approaches to uncover actionable, proprietary opportunities.
  • Represent Toptal in founder conversations, demonstrating empathy, professionalism, and strategic insight.
  • Deal Execution
  • Lead commercial, financial, and operational diligence in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
  • Develop compelling deal theses and valuation models tailored to each opportunity.
  • Negotiate deal terms and structure, working closely with internal and external legal counsel.
  • Executive Engagement
  • Present and defend deal rationale, strategic fit, and risks to senior executives including the CEO.
  • Clearly communicate trade-offs and integration implications of each transaction.
  • Integration & Monitoring
  • Partner with functional leads to build and oversee execution of integration plans.
  • Track post-close performance of acquired companies, escalate risks early, and drive accountability.
  • Team Development & Best Practices
  • Help codify Toptal’s M&A playbook and continuously refine sourcing, diligence, and integration frameworks.
  • Mentor junior team members and champion a culture of excellence, urgency, and ownership.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in M&A, corporate development, investment banking, or private equity; experience with tech services or product-based acquisitions strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing and closing small-cap, founder-led deals, particularly in talent marketplaces, IT services, or product-led companies.
  • Experience initiating and managing founder outreach, including cold engagement and relationship development.
  • Strong comfort juggling multiple engagements simultaneously and managing execution under time pressure.
  • Hands-on experience with post-acquisition integration and performance monitoring.
  • Proven ability to present and defend deals to C-level leadership and boards.
  • Deep understanding of valuation, deal structuring, and strategic fit analysis.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to move fast in a lean, high-accountability environment.
  • Exceptional modeling skills in Excel and ability to use Google Sheets.
  • Relentless attention to detail and a bias for action.
  • Must have excellent written and oral communication skills. You must be a strong communicator able to work with a wide range of stakeholders from senior executives to individual contributors.
  • Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution, as well as mentor others to do the same.
  • Adaptable. Comfortable managing changing priorities, learning new skills, and building consensus across varied senior stakeholder groups.
  • Ownership. You are a dependable leader who takes responsibility for your success as well as the success of the entire team.
  • Quality. You take pride in everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Seniority level

  • Director

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Business Development, Consulting, and Strategy/Planning

Industries

  • Software Development, Professional Services, and IT Services and IT Consulting

About the Role

WordPress VIP (WPVIP), the enterprise division of Automattic, is the world’s leading content management platform. Our goal is to bring the ease and agility of WordPress to the world’s largest companies. We work with customers like Salesforce, Facebook, CNN, Slack, Time, Capgemini, and hundreds more to empower their teams to produce digital content faster and smarter, while also ensuring premium security and scalability.

We’re looking for a Director of Business Development to design and lead our global BDR strategy, programs, and team to fuel our growth engine. This role reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and will work closely with marketing, sales, product, and operations stakeholders.

The Director will oversee all BDR motions—inbound qualification and outbound prospecting —while also building the next-generation AI-powered outbound workflow that modernizes how we identify, engage, and qualify enterprise prospects. You’ll be expected to combine strategic vision with operational execution: setting the blueprint for scalable processes, playbooks, and reporting that deliver measurable impact.

We’re looking for a proven B2B sales development leader who thrives at building high-performing teams and has the foresight to integrate AI, automation, and data into every stage of outbound engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Own the global BDR function, covering inbound qualification and outbound prospecting, ensuring both volume and quality of opportunities.
  • Conceive and deploy a comprehensive AI-driven outbound workflow including prospect identification, intent-based targeting, message personalization, sequencing, and reporting.
  • Partner with marketing and sales leadership to define the right customer segments, leveraging AI insights to sharpen targeting and increase conversion.
  • Build frameworks, enablement, and processes that allow BDRs to quickly adjust strategy based on market signals and intelligence surfaced by AI tools.
  • Develop clear forecasting models aligning targets, team capacity, and outcomes.
  • Manage BDR capacity and productivity to ensure targets are met, with transparent reporting and dashboards.
  • Recruit, develop, and motivate BDRs to exceed goals through coaching, enablement, and structured career development.
  • Ensure successful onboarding and continual development of BDR talent in partnership with sales ops and product marketing.
  • Define the blueprint for data, processes, and technology (Salesforce, Pardot, Outreach, ABM platforms, and emerging AI sales tech) to maximize efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Deliver both quality and quantity of opportunities in partnership with sales and marketing, closely tracking metrics like win rate, AOV, and pipeline attainment.

Qualifications

  • Prior experience—preferably at SaaS companies—building, leading, and scaling BDR teams of 20+
  • Demonstrated ability to design AI-powered sales development workflows : enrichment, lead scoring, personalization, sequencing, and reporting.
  • Track record of building methodologies, processes, and operational plans for successful inbound and outbound programs.
  • Strong people leadership skills: recruiting, motivating, and coaching BDR teams to drive results and engagement.
  • Ability to balance quick wins with medium- and long-term blueprint for sustainable BDR effectiveness.
  • Deep knowledge of sales outreach workflows and the role of tools and platforms—including AI-enabled ones—for enablement, reporting, and productivity.
  • Strong collaboration skills to partner across marketing, sales, and IT to drive measurable outcomes.

Location: Remote (US/Canada)

Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind WordPress.com, WooCommerce, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, Beeper, and more.

We’re a distributed company with more than 1400 Automatticians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source.

About the role

We are seeking a Head of Data Implementations & Operations to join our Operations team. This group is essential to Garner’s ability to provide a seamless and accurate benefits experience for our members. We manage key data connections that support our products, including establishing new data feeds with healthcare carriers and performing continuous maintenance to ensure that claims, eligibility, and provider data remain accurate and reliable. Getting this right is crucial for our members’ ability to use and trust Garner.

This position is fully remote and reports to the VP of Operations.

What you will do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team responsible for the end-to-end implementation and ongoing maintenance of data feeds from carriers, TPAs, PBMs, and benefits administration systems
  • Develop and scale the operational processes for data and network configuration, driving improvements in efficiency, quality, and timeliness to support Garner’s growth
  • Act as the senior leader for the data implementations function, serving as a point of escalation and representing the team in strategic meetings with key clients and partners
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership to drive strategic projects, improve tooling, and ensure the implementation process scales effectively
  • Act as the subject matter expert for your team, guiding them through complex troubleshooting of data file issues and overseeing the research and implementation of provider network configurations
  • Hold the team accountable to high standards of operational excellence, establishing key metrics and processes to ensure data is onboarded accurately and securely

What you will bring to the team

  • 5+ years of experience in an operations role within a fast-paced startup, high-growth tech company, or other complex, high-performance organization

  • Strong data fluency and analytical skills, and a strategic mindset with the ability to learn complex systems quickly, identify opportunities for process improvement, and execute on them effectively
  • Exceptional project management and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to manage difficult conversations and build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical counterparts
  • Preferred Experience:
    • Familiarity with healthcare data sets, particularly claims and eligibility files
    • Knowledge of common data exchange tools and protocols, including SFTP, ETL processes, and data mapping
    • Proficiency with SQL and Google Sheets for data analysis and manipulation

title: Fotógrafo Imobiliário | São José dos Campos - SP
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


Como são realizadas as sessões?



  • Cada ensaio leva, em média, 1 hora para ser produzido;

  • A quantidade de fotos por sessão varia de 20 a 60;

  • Devem ser feitas 2 fotos da fachada e dos ambientes das áreas comuns do condomínio;

  • Na unidade, devem ser registradas de 2 a 4 fotos de cada ambiente;

  • As fotos devem ser entregues editadas, utilizando os presets do Lightroom disponibilizados;

  • Em casos pontuais, deve-se aplicar blur em placas imobiliárias e em informações pessoais, íntimas ou sensíveis;

  • Os vídeos envolvem apenas a captura, pois a edição é feita pela Piperz;

  • As sessões são realizadas de segunda a sábado, das 08h00 às 17h00;

  • Você pode definir bloqueios na agenda e receber sessões somente em dias e horários específicos;

  • É possível realizar até 6 sessões por dia, podendo variar conforme sua qualidade, atendimento e a demanda da cidade;

  • O pagamento é mensal: você recebe no dia 10 de cada mês o valor total das sessões realizadas no mês anterior;

  • Até o dia 03 de cada mês, é necessário emitir as notas fiscais referentes às sessões realizadas e anexá-las na plataforma;

  • O valor do ensaio somente com fotos é de R$ 59, e de Foto + Vídeo é de R$ 81 para imóveis de até 200 m²;

  • Para imóveis acima de 200 m², você recebe R$ 18 a cada 100 m² adicionais em Foto + Vídeo, e R$ 12 em sessões apenas de Foto;

  • Em caso de cancelamento com menos de 2h de antecedência ou já em deslocamento, você recebe uma taxa de R$ 27.


Requisitos e qualificações


O que você precisa para se tornar um fotógrafo imobiliário da Piperz?


Disponibilidade: O fotógrafo precisa ter disponibilidade e acompanhar a agenda através da plataforma da Piperz. Todos os dias, entre 17h e 18h, a agenda do dia seguinte é disponibilizada na plataforma.


Agilidade: Temos o compromisso de atender nossos clientes com rapidez, e contamos com você para manter a mesma dedicação. Após a realização dos ensaios agendados, é necessário efetuar a edição em lote pelo Lightroom e enviar o material para a plataforma até as 00h. Assim, você evita acúmulo de demanda e contribui para a satisfação dos clientes.


Equipamento: É necessário ter uma câmera com objetiva grande-angular de distância focal curta (pode ser Full Frame ou Crop – Sensor APS-C ), pois ela transmite a sensação de amplitude dos ambientes.



  • Lentes recomendadas Full Frame: 17-40mm, 16-35mm, 15-35mm

  • Lentes recomendadas APS-C (Crop): 10-18mm, 10-20mm, 10-22mm


CNPJ: É obrigatório possuir CNPJ ativo, pois todos os pagamentos são realizados mediante emissão de nota fiscal, garantindo transparência e segurança em todas as transações.


Teste: Antes de começar a receber ensaios, você realizará um teste técnico para validarmos a qualidade do seu trabalho. O teste é simples: basta enviar alguns materiais já captados, simulando uma sessão real recebida pela plataforma.


Cadastro: Após aprovação no teste, será necessário enviar um documento de identificação com foto e um comprovante de residência para validar sua identidade e concluir o cadastro.


Conta bancária: Para receber os pagamentos de forma rápida e segura, é necessário informar uma conta bancária ativa em seu nome ou vinculada ao CNPJ informado. Todos os valores referentes aos ensaios realizados serão depositados diretamente nessa conta, garantindo transparência, segurança e controle total dos seus recebimentos.


Informações adicionais


O que o fotógrafo imobiliário cadastrado na Piperz recebe?



  • Acesso à plataforma da Piperz, onde você realiza a entrega dos materiais, visualiza os detalhes das sessões e acompanha seus ganhos;

  • Acesso à carteira de clientes da Piperz, produzindo ensaios para as maiores marcas do mercado imobiliário, sem precisar se preocupar com a parte comercial;

  • Acesso aos presets de edição do Lightroom, desenvolvidos pelo nosso time;

  • Suporte via WhatsApp, para tirar dúvidas sobre o uso da plataforma e o fluxo de trabalho;

  • Liberdade para definir sua região de atuação, além dos dias e horários em que deseja receber sessões;

  • Muitas oportunidades de ensaios, para encher sua agenda e, consequentemente, aumentar seus ganhos mensais.

Fraser Health is embracing virtual methods to enhance patient care. This position provides entirely virtual clinical services. The Virtual Psychiatry Unit delivers acute Mental Health and Substance Use care to clients across the Fraser Health Region in a team-based, inter-professional care environment.   • Vivência em Big Techs: ter atuado na área de desenvolvimento de empresas de tecnologia de ponta, acumulando conhecimento e prática em ambientes altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Buscamos pessoas movidas por intensa motivação e prontas para enfrentar os desafios da jornada empreendedora.   • Boilerplate de tecnologia: você contará com um boilerplate + design system robusto disponibilizado pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. About AlphaSense

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team

AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.

If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We are seeking a visionary Senior Product Manager with a deep understanding of our core users’ workflows to drive the evolution of our product in the AI-first world. AI has changed what’s possible, and in this role, you will leverage your understanding of our customers’ use cases and artificial intelligence technologies to identify opportunities. You will challenge conventional thinking and ensure that AI is at the forefront of solving our customers\' problems. You will play a critical role in market research, shaping the product roadmap, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that our AI-driven solutions deliver measurable business value.

Who You Are

  • Direct experience as an Investment Banking Analyst or as one of our core buyside customers (Hedge Fund, Venture Capital, Private Equity, or Asset Management)
  • Strategic thinker with technical knowledge
  • Clear communicator
  • Demonstrated traction in learning, adopting, and staying on top of emerging AI tools and trends
  • Adaptable and resilient
  • Analytical mindset – able to balance business goals with technical capabilities. Ability to leverage basic data analytics and SQL.

What You’ll Do

  • Champion the customer perspective: Shape and execute AI product strategies that directly address user needs and business goals.
  • Rapidly iterate on AI prompts and outputs: Design, test, and refine prompts and model configurations to ensure our AI delivers accurate, relevant, and high-quality results—moving fast to ship improvements and new features.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work side-by-side with product, engineering, design, and product marketing to build, launch, and optimize innovative AI solutions tailored to our customers.
  • Identify opportunities: Analyze market trends, emerging AI models, and competitor moves to identify where we can leap ahead.
  • Engage with customers: Gather feedback, run user sessions, and translate insights into actionable product enhancements.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Monitor AI tool performance, troubleshoot issues, and relentlessly push for better accuracy, speed, and user experience.

Base Compensation Range $169,000 — $219,000 USD

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

About the role

As the Head of User Experience, you will provide strategic leadership and champion a design-centric culture focused on delivering exceptional, developer-centric solutions for enterprises. You will define and execute a cohesive UX strategy, overseeing the evolution of user experiences and design systems to ensure simplicity, scalability, and efficiency.

A visionary leader and systems-level thinker, you will inspire a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, fostering continuous learning and expertise in design methodologies. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, integrating design vision into development strategies.

With a deep understanding of developer needs, you will confidently advocate for user-centric practices, defend design solutions, and influence decision-making. You will actively engage the developer community, gathering insights, validating solutions, and refining offerings based on user feedback and data.

As a fierce advocate for users, you are committed to creating elegantly simple experiences from complex workflows, leveraging your strong design acumen and user-focused mindset.

On a daily routine you will..

  • Provide strategic leadership and vision for the UX organization, defining and executing a cohesive design strategy that aligns with product roadmaps and business objectives.
  • Champion a design-centric culture across the organization, fostering critical thinking, creativity, user-centricity, and a focus on delivering innovative, simple, and intuitive experiences that simplify complex processes for developers.
  • Lead and inspire a high-performing multidisciplinary UX team, creating an environment that values continuous learning, growth, and the sharing of deep expertise in design methodologies, frameworks, interaction models, prototyping, and research.
  • Oversee the evolution of design systems, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency in UX efforts, while driving alignment and weighing the impact and trade-offs of design decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product leaders, engineering teams, and stakeholders to seamlessly integrate design vision and user experience into product development strategies and execution.
  • Actively engage with the developer community, gather insights, discover problems, validate solutions, and continuously refine product offerings based on user feedback, usability testing, and data-driven insights.
  • Confidently defend design solutions and advocate for user-centered design practices, leveraging data, customer insights, and a deep understanding of developer needs to influence decision-making.
  • Foster an environment of big-picture thinking and continuous improvement by leading brainstorming, critique sessions, and identifying opportunities to drive quality and efficiency within the team.
  • Represent Digibee as a thought leader in the design community, showcasing the company's design innovation and leadership at industry events, conferences, and broader forums.

What you’ll need to bring...

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, with a significant track record in leadership positions.
  • Deep understanding of developer tooling and the specific needs of developers in the B2B space is essential. Experience leading product design for B2B products designed for developers is highly desired.
  • Proven ability to lead and inspire a design team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate design vision and strategy to all stakeholders.

  • Advanced or fluent English language proficiency

  • We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education)
  • Life insurance
  • Child care assistance
  • Gympass

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

LastPass is a leader in password and identity management, making it easier to log into life and work. LastPass is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Commerce Platform

LastPass is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Commerce & FinTech Systems Team. We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive the platform strategy, roadmap and optimization of every purchase, upgrade and renewal flow—putting your customer journey hat on to make buying LastPass seamless for our omni-channel customer-base. You’ll make it easy for our Growth and Product teams to move faster, with accurate data, compliant execution, and global scale.

About the Team:

You will join the Business Technology (BT) org, reporting to the Director of Commerce & FinTech Systems.

The Commerce & FinTech Systems team is a key driver of LastPass’s global expansion, revenue operations, and customer monetization strategies. By partnering across Finance, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, and Engineering, this team delivers scalable financial infrastructure and processes that support monetization and customer experiences.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You’ll partner daily with Growth Marketing, Product, Web/UX, Engineering, RevOps, Finance, Care, and Security—aligning platform readiness with offer strategy, pricing & packaging, and go-to-market plans. Remote-first culture with strong collaboration across US and EU time zones.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Own the Commerce Platform roadmap: balance quick-wins work with strategic programs and long-term scalability.

  • Payment strategy optimization: lead initiatives to improve authorization rates, reduce payment failures, and expand support for global payment methods and gateways.

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Experience in Product Management / Product Ownership for monetization or commerce platforms in SaaS.
  • Hands-on expertise with Zuora billing (or similar), payment gateways (e.g. CyberSource), and payment optimization strategies.
  • Strong systems + data mindset: API-first design, event models, source-of-truth concepts; ability to validate flows with SQL/BI (Looker/Tableau/GA4).

  • Excellent stakeholder management across Finance, Legal, RevOps, Growth, Product, Engineering, and Security; crisp specs and executive storytelling.

About the role

As part of our mission to make data and cloud fluency accessible to all, you’ll lead a dynamic team of instructors, content creators, and technologists to craft cutting-edge courses and projects that shape the future of cloud education. Cloud technologies are transforming how businesses operate, with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP at the forefront. As our Head of Cloud Curriculum, you’ll be instrumental in driving this transformation, helping learners worldwide build the skills they need to succeed.

In this role, you’ll own the cloud content strategy and roadmap, working hand-in-hand with our expert instructors and the broader Cloud Curriculum team — a talented group of educators, data scientists, and technologists. Your focus will be to continuously grow and enrich our cloud content library with impactful new materials. From courses to practice pools to real-world projects, you’ll serve as a thought partner, reviewer, and passionate advocate for our learners.

With a strong technical foundation in platforms like AWS and Azure, and the ability to influence across functions, you\'ll make data-driven decisions and successfully lead complex, high-impact projects. If you have a genuine passion for cloud education and are excited to shape the next generation of cloud professionals while building the world\'s premier network of cloud instructors, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we look for individuals who embody our core values: data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and an unwavering focus on our learners. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for democratizing access to data and cloud technologies.

Your entrepreneurial mindset and collaborative spirit push you beyond simply meeting targets — you’re motivated to empower learners worldwide to succeed in an increasingly cloud-first world. You\'re a true team player who enjoys working across functions: whether you\'re partnering with internal engineering, product, marketing, sales, and support teams, or rolling up your sleeves to strategize directly with clients, you bring energy and curiosity to every collaboration.

You believe that people, processes, technology, and data are the essential ingredients for digital transformation — and you\'re energized by the opportunity to help learners advance their cloud knowledge and skills. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will focus your time on the following areas:

  • Define the Vision: Set the strategy for our Cloud Curriculum roadmap (AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud engineering, DevOps, and beyond).
  • Lead and Inspire: Manage a talented team of content developers and collaborate with external experts to create best-in-class learning experiences.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor industry trends and emerging cloud technologies to keep our curriculum at the forefront.
  • Drive Impact: Build engaging, practical learning paths that help learners unlock career opportunities and enable enterprise teams to scale cloud adoption.
  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Partner closely with product, marketing, and enterprise teams to ensure our curriculum meets the evolving needs of learners and customers.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of management experience, leading teams to success.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, services, and industry best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS and/or Azure) are a plus but not required.
  • Passion for working collaboratively with subject matter experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with interactive technical education platforms like DataCamp or similar.
  • Ability to synthesize, visualize, and clearly communicate complex ideas, including to non-technical audiences.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable challenging ideas constructively and knowing when to push back or seek compromise to drive the best outcomes for the company.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible!
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we\'re awesome!

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

At DataCamp, we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don\'t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We believe skills can be developed and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Your unique talents and perspectives are what make our team great!

description:
About Us

Syniti is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.

Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.

As an innovative, global leader in Enterprise Data Management, the combination of our award-winning software platform and premier consultants creates a unique advantage for leading enterprises. Syniti is also a preferred data solution used by the world’s top system integrators. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.

The Role

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a managing data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be managing a team of lead data migration consultants and data migration developers on all aspects of work for a data migration project. You will also work directly with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops to ensure that all in scope conversion objects are covered by the team. You will be responsible for ensuring the entire team is executing against a plan that you will develop in collaboration with customer PMO, and that both you and the team are meeting customer and Syniti delivery requirements. As a leader of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do

After an initial training period, a Managing Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a full team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Ensure all team members are developing data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Contribute to ongoing project planning with customer PMO, with full responsibility for ensuring that all data related activities are strongly accounted for.
  • Author, maintain and supply all related strategy documentation.
  • Clearly communicate weekly status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Ensure all administrative tasks related to staffing, forecasting and reporting are timely to meet customer and Syniti needs.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.

What It Takes

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • PMP background and/or certification.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.

What We Offer

  • Trust that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

About This Role
The Salesforce team works within the Digital Transformation unit to empower Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support with CRM solutions that support our market growth. You will be accountable for ensuring that Salesforce delivers value across all customer-facing teams through scalable, high-quality, and relevant solutions.
You will collaborate with Salesforce architects, developers, administrators, business analysts, designers, and cross-functional business units to design best-in-class CRM experiences. Partnering with Business Units, you will define and manage the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Salesforce across the company, leading the translation of business needs into a prioritized product backlog.
To be successful in this role, you will need a strong background in product management, CRM systems, and stakeholder management. You should also be highly collaborative, thrive in ambiguity and fast-paced environments, and have excellent communication and leadership skills.
What You Will Lead/Do Or Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and evolve the Salesforce user experience, data model, and configurations to support business processes
  • Deliver automation, workflows, and integrations that drive productivity and enable accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility
  • Ensure data integrity and user adoption across the platform
  • Lead a cross-functional team of architects, developers, admins, and business analysts
  • Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Salesforce CRM
  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, CS, Support, and Finance to gather requirements and prioritize solutions
  • Challenge existing CRM processes to identify opportunities for efficiency and automation
  • Communicate the roadmap and deliverables across the organization
  • Foster adoption of new features and workflows
  • Define and track success metrics
  • Own and prioritize the backlog and delivery process, partnering closely with the Salesforce admin/dev team
  • Manage expectations across business stakeholders, providing visibility and clarity at each stage of delivery
Qualifications / What You Need To Succeed
  • Background in Product Management, Computer Science, CRM, Digital Transformation, or Business Process Optimization
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud (Service Cloud, CPQ, or Marketing Cloud) is a plus)
  • Familiarity with CRM reporting, forecasting, and pipeline management
  • Understanding of CRM data models, user roles, profiles, and permissions
  • Experience working with Salesforce Architects to deliver solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Prior experience in Agile environments and backlog management tools like Jira
  • Bonus: Salesforce Certifications; Marketing or Sales background in a B2B organization
The Longer Story
OutSystems enables enterprise teams to build AI-powered applications and agents that reduce manual work, streamline internal operations, and accelerate impact. A proven low-code foundation combined with agentic AI and AI app generation capabilities empowers teams to move up to 10x faster with the assurance of security, scalability, and governance built in.
As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities—but inside the enterprise, things are moving fast and feeling chaotic. Some early adopters are making progress in production, but for many, AI tools are sprawling without governance, data isn’t ready, and talent isn’t there yet. Enterprises are still drowning in application backlogs and struggling with legacy systems. But with the right platform, AI doesn’t have to add to the chaos. It can become the breakthrough that brings clarity—and drives real, enterprise-wide impact. At OutSystems, we’ve built that platform, providing the tools necessary for enterprises to overcome these hurdles.
We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us in helping our customers build, deploy, and scale apps and agents—fast, helping them accelerate innovation while enabling secure, governed human-AI collaboration.
OutSystems is a truly global company, with more than 850,000 developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 500 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and of course has a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.
Amongst our 2,400 customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries—brands like Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA. These customers are the reason we have a 4.6 star rating on G2. Their success is ours, and their stories demonstrate tangible ROI and transformational impact. We are a 9x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for Low-Code Application Platforms and a multi-year leader in the Forrester Wave. We’re recognized not just as leaders but as visionaries with a strong ability to execute, now extending our leadership into the AI and agentic application development arena.
Working at OutSystems
Our goal is to ensure that OutSystems is a place for bright, happy, and motivated people who share a common purpose and take pride in doing excellent work to pursue our vision of providing the AI-powered low-code development platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their business applications, agents, and core systems. Our culture is focused on our core values of trust, customer success, innovation, and alignment. Our team members operate with transparency, integrity, and accountability, define success through the lens of the outcomes we deliver for our customers, push the boundaries with excellence, and work together toward our shared vision to deliver on what matters most.
What do we have to offer you?
  • A company that is always growing, changing, and innovating. We challenge each other to innovate in our products, in our team, and how we use our own technology. And we give our teams space to be proactive and creative.
  • Real career opportunities. We care about growth and development. Yes, vertical career progression is a possibility, but it's not the only one. From lateral moves and joining different teams to mastering specialized skills, we support your growth no matter what your goals are.
  • Work colleagues that are as smart, hard-working, and driven as you. We act as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership and working together toward a shared vision.
  • Disrupting the status quo is in our DNA. In fact, it’s why our company exists.
  • We ask “why” a lot. It helps us connect our individual work to the bigger picture and sometimes even uncover a better way.
Are you ready for the next step in your career? Then we’d love to hear from you!
OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture of diversity, where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic self and perform at their best. A company that embraces the creativity and innovation that comes through diverse perspectives. We’re hiring a Head of Software Engineering to own the architectural health, scalability, and performance of our SEO platform. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments yet brings the rigor and best practices learned from larger organizations.

You will partner with the VP of Engineering to set the technical direction of our platform, oversee refactoring initiatives, and lead efforts to optimize infrastructure, performance, and code quality across all services. Your mission is to make our systems faster, more reliable, and easier to maintain, enabling product teams to move quickly without compromising long-term stability.

This is a hands-on leadership position. You will dive deep into complex backend systems, review critical code paths, and guide large-scale refactors, while also mentoring engineers and enforcing architectural standards. You will have a strong backend foundation in Python/Django, solid infrastructure skills, and the flexibility to adapt solutions pragmatically in a startup context.

  • Please upload your resume in English

  • Define and maintain long-term platform architecture and establish coding standards across engineering teams
  • Lead large-scale refactoring projects to improve maintainability, scalability, and performance
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across API, database, and infrastructure layers
  • Optimize task queues, background processing, caching, and deployment pipelines
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to senior engineers, ensuring high-quality, maintainable code
  • Collaborate with infrastructure teams on observability, reliability, security, and cost-efficient scaling
  • Lead incident postmortems with root-cause analysis and long-term fixes

  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role (Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, or Tech Lead)

  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise, including indexing, query optimization, and schema design
  • Proficiency in Celery or similar distributed task processing systems
  • Strong infrastructure foundation, containerization (Docker), CI/CD, Kubernetes familiarity, monitoring, and alerting
  • Experience with observability tools like Sentry, Datadog, and Grafana

description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships, and understand needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, and exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

Overview

Who we are is what we do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 6,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We’re not just building software; we’re creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator’s top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $12 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

Deel is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Director of Corporate Security to lead and oversee two critical teams: IT Security and Security Operations (SecOps) . This leader will be responsible for safeguarding Deel’s technology ecosystem, ensuring strong defenses against cyber threats, and building scalable security strategies to protect the company’s assets, data, and people.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with proven leadership ability and thrives in a fast-paced, global, and high-growth environment.

Responsibilities

IT Security Team

  • Act as the system owner for Deel’s security platforms (ZTNA, SWG, enterprise browser, DLP, EDR, etc.).

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and oversee resolution across security tools and infrastructure.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to remediate security risks identified by Deel’s security tools or security architects.

  • Ensure security systems are fully integrated, optimized, and aligned with Deel’s enterprise security strategy.

Security Operations (SecOps) Team

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve Deel’s monitoring and alerting strategy .

  • Manage communication and incident coordination with Deel’s SIEM and SOC providers , ensuring incidents are tracked and resolved effectively.

  • Design and maintain security dashboards for visibility and metrics reporting across the company.

  • Act as Tier 3 escalation for security incidents and investigations, providing advanced technical guidance.

  • Develop and execute Deel’s insider threat detection and response strategy .

  • Define and implement SIEM correlation rules to detect emerging threats.

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve security playbooks to ensure rapid, consistent incident response.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in security, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing IT Security and/or SecOps.

  • Strong technical expertise with enterprise security systems (ZTNA, SWG, DLP, EDR, SIEM, etc.).

  • Proven experience with SOC practices, digital forensics, and incident response.

  • Deep knowledge of monitoring, detection, and insider threat strategies.

  • Strong leadership, team-building, and mentoring skills.

  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities in high-pressure environments.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to partner across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GIAC, etc.) strongly preferred.

Overview

Senior Cloud Solution Architect- Automation

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

Cloud Platform Proficiency :

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

Embedded Systems and CI / CD :

  • Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.

Architecture Design :

  • Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.

NET Development Skills :

  • Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

Integration with SAP and Salesforce :

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

Security and Compliance :

  • Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

Scalability and High Availability :

  • Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

Agile Development Practices :

  • Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking :

description:
Overview

Senior Product Manager, Payroll — Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. All positions are fully remote.

What This Job Can Offer You

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global payroll space. You will develop a deep understanding of customer needs and pain points, and work with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that provide an exceptional payroll experience. You will lead within your development team and collaborate with internal experts across operations, compliance, sales, product marketing, and more to build a scalable payroll platform for 80+ markets worldwide.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a senior product manager in a multi-product, high-growth scale-up.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and HR functions; hands-on payroll software experience preferred.
  • Experience launching products or features that leveraged AI.
  • Good judgment for strategic prioritization and tactical scope decisions.
  • Data-driven with experience setting and tracking goals to achieve results.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration across departments (operations, business, sales, finance, etc.).
  • Business-level English proficiency.
  • Strong stakeholder management.
  • Can-do attitude with collaborative problem-solving and speed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build the future of payroll with senior product leaders at Remote.
  • Lead efforts across engineering, design, and operations to launch high-impact projects.
  • Deliver outcomes that differentiate Remote; collaborate with engineers, designers, and operations to build elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Shape and deliver improvements in focused areas of the product and advance key KPIs.
  • Collaborate with partner teams to connect roadmaps to stakeholder needs; model asynchronous workflows and transparency.
  • Use AI tools to increase productivity, decision-making, and workflow efficiency.

Application Process

  • Interview with recruiter
  • Interview with future manager
  • Interview with team members (no managers present)
  • Bar Raiser Interview
  • Prior employment verification check

Compensation and Benefits

Remote’s total rewards philosophy includes fair, unbiased compensation and equity pay with competitive benefits in all locations. Base salaries are determined by role, level, location and market demands. The annual salary range for this full-time position is $54,900—$154,400 USD.

  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Flexible working hours (asynchronous)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • Mental health support services
  • Stock options
  • Learning budget
  • Home office budget & equipment

How You’ll Plan Your Day

We work asynchronously at Remote, so you can plan your schedule around your life. Details at remote.com/async. You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive; life-work balance is encouraged.

How To Apply

  • Fill out the form and upload your CV in PDF format.
  • Submit your application and CV in English.
  • If you don’t have an up-to-date CV, add your LinkedIn profile.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations upon request. Remote is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce.

Caylent is a cloud native services company that helps organizations bring the best out of their people and technology using Amazon Web Services (AWS). We provide a full-range of AWS services including workload migrations and modernization, cloud native application development, DevOps, data engineering, security and compliance, and everything in between.
At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a global company and operate fully remote with employees in Canada, the United States, and Latin America. The Mission
We are seeking a seasoned Director of Cloud Native Applications to join our growing App Dev practice. The ideal candidate brings a passion for modern software development, a strong customer orientation, and a proven ability to lead teams through complex technical engagements. Your mission will be to guide project delivery, support escalations, enable our engineering teams, and collaborate with clients and sales leaders to shape high-impact solutions. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring technical excellence, scaling our delivery capabilities, and helping customers bring cutting-edge applications to life in AWS.
Your Assignment

This individual will take part in setting the technical vision, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring the successful delivery of cloud native applications for clients of all sizes. The role requires deep expertise in application development, strong knowledge in AWS technologies, a strong business acumen, and the ability to lead a large, diverse team in a fast-paced environment.

  • Practice Leadership: Take part in Defining and executing the strategic vision for the Cloud Native Applications Practice, ensuring alignment with company objectives and AWS best practices.
  • Technical Excellence: Establish and promote industry-leading methodologies, frameworks, and architectures for cloud-native solutions.
  • People Management: Lead and mentor a team of 50+ software engineers, architects, and consultants, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
  • Delivery Excellence: Oversee the successful execution of customer engagements, ensuring high-quality delivery, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
  • AWS Partnership: Strengthen our collaboration with AWS, leveraging latest technologies and programs to enhance our service offerings.
  • Business Growth: Support pre-sales efforts, contribute to go-to-market strategies, and help drive revenue growth by aligning technical capabilities with business opportunities.
  • Innovation & Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of industry trends, drive innovation within the practice, and represent the company in conferences, webinars, and AWS-related events.
  • AI & Emerging Technologies Leadership: Drive the development and implementation of AI-powered solutions both internally and for our customers
Qualifications:
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering and software development, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading and scaling an engineering practice or department, ideally within an AWS-focused services company.
  • Proven experience leading and delivering large (multi-million dollar) software project
  • Deep expertise in AWS services, architectures, and best practices
  • Deep expertise in software development patterns, architectures, and best practices
  • Strong background in DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients across various industries.
  • Experience working with cross-practice teams (talent, sales, marketing, operations etc).
  • Experience building, delivering, and using GenAI products and solutions
Preferred Qualifications
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience working in a client-facing environment
  • Experience working in consulting or professional services
  • Experience working in a product focused SaaS company
